headline: The wind has finally let go - 22 km/h gusts against 78 at this hour yesterday - and that makes today the ride.
body:
Today is the ride. Gusts run **22 early, 26 midday, 26 evening**, against **78** yesterday morning - bike reads good in all three windows for the first time in this file, and open water is good before 11:00.

Take **60-75 minutes and no more**: **26-28 km/h at 131-150 bpm** on the flat, cap the climbs at **155** and keep pedalling on the descents. The last HRV row I hold is **69 against a 66.9 mean** - green, but it is two days old. On 24 September you were told easy and rode **96.5 km with 1,556 m**; today is not that day.

The sync has not pushed since **Sunday 14:22** - **42 hours**, four windows missed. No file for Monday, no wellness row for Monday or this morning, so I am not calling Monday anything. What did you do, and is the machine awake?

Nine days since the race run. Before I put a run back in - how is the ankle?
